_notes._readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which model each role uses. JSON holds only role -> model; the role of each agent file is read from its own options.model_role. apply-models.sh rewrites the model: line in every agent file from THIS map. Preferred workflow: run the /setup command once per machine instead of hand-editing this file.
_notes._usage: Manual alternative: 1) Edit the model value(s) below to exact IDs available in opencode (see `opencode models`). 2) Run: bash apply-models.sh [path-to-this-file] [target-dir]. Target dir defaults to ~/.config/opencode/agent. 3) Restart opencode.
_notes._defaults: Defaults below are verified against `opencode models` on this machine.
_notes._scanning: scanning = Requirement Gathering (req-gathering). Pick the largest-context, lowest-cost model you have.
_notes._design: design = design/review-heavy agents (orchestrate, hld-designer, flows-identifier, test-generator, lld, spec-writer). Pick your strongest reasoning model.
_notes._coding: coding = execution agents (implementation, scaffold, planner, implementer, integration, qa, dev). Pick a fast/cheap model.
